title: Oral-B Launches Floral iO Style Series Toothbrush at Target
html:
Combining Oral-B’s advanced iO cleaning and whitening technology with a fresh, floral-inspired design, the new electric toothbrush brings style to everyday oral care, exclusively at Target.

Oral-B is bringing a beauty-forward approach to everyday oral care with the launch of the Oral-B iO Style Series, exclusively at Target. Blending the advanced cleaning technology of the iO Series with the brand’s first-ever floral-inspired handle design, the new electric toothbrush celebrates the role of a healthy smile in everyday beauty routines, adding a little more personality to the bathroom counter.

The Oral-B iO Style Series elevates everyday brushing with advanced technology and features, including:

  • Dentist-Inspired Round Brush Head: Precisely angled bristles surround each tooth to lift and remove plaque, delivering a superior clean compared to a regular manual toothbrush.
  • Whiter Teeth Starting Day 1: Helps remove surface stains for a visibly brighter smile from the very first day.
  • Automatic Gum Pressure Sensor: Detects when users are brushing too hard and automatically slows down to help protect gums.
  • Three Cleaning Settings: Easily switch between three cleaning settings with one simple touch for a personalized brushing experience.
  • Built-In Two-Minute Timer: Helps users brush for the dentist-recommended two minutes, encouraging consistent oral care habits.
  • Long-Lasting Rechargeable Battery: Delivers up to 28 days of use on a single charge, making it easy to maintain a routine at home or on the go.

“Beauty routines are about the little moments of care we make time for every day, and we believe a perfect clean for all teeth deserves a place in that ritual,” said Suhashini Vittal, vice president of Oral-B. “With the new Oral-B iO Style Series, we’re bringing together the innovative cleaning performance Oral-B is known for with a fresh, expressive design. It’s a reminder that beauty can bloom in every part of your routine, starting with your smile.”

Just in time for the holiday season, the Oral-B iO Style Series makes the perfect gift for beauty lovers of all ages. To accompany the launch, Oral-B is partnering with beauty and lifestyle creator Monet McMichael, whose nursing credentials bring a unique perspective to the intersection of beauty and oral health. Combining her passion for beauty with her appreciation for the importance of oral health and, therefore, overall health, McMichael is adding the iO Style Series to her holiday routine this year.

“Beauty and self-care have always been a big part of my everyday routine, and I believe taking care of your oral health deserves as much attention, if not more, than skincare or makeup,” said Monet McMichael, content creator and Oral-B partner. “That’s why I’m so excited to partner with Oral-B for the launch of the new iO Style Series, which brings a beauty-inspired touch to my oral care routine with a floral design that looks just as good on my vanity as all my other favorite essentials!”

Availability and Pricing: The Oral-B iO Style Series is now available exclusively at Target stores nationwide and on Target.com for $59.99.

About Oral-B

Oral-B is the worldwide leader in the over-$5 billion brushing market, drawing upon more than 75 years of expertise to empower healthier lives for all through better oral care. The brand features a wide variety of products to build a personalized oral care routine for the best clean every time, including manual, battery-powered, and electric toothbrushes for children and adults, as well as interdental products such as dental floss. Oral-B’s iO Series electric toothbrushes feature the latest in brushing technology, with a dentist-inspired round brush head that removes 100% more plaque than regular manual brushes, for cleaner teeth and healthier gums.
